---
name: "✨ Feature Request"
about: Propose a new feature, botanical model upgrade, or UI enhancement for GreenGuard
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the proposed feature is.

## 🌿 Problem Statement / Use Case
What problem does this solve? Describe the user story or botanical concern (e.g., "As an adopter, I want to receive weekly push notifications detailing my plant's growth status").

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
A detailed explanation of how you visualize this feature working. Detail which components would change:
- **Frontend Changes** (e.g., new atmospheric backgrounds, page transitions, interactive map widgets)
- **Backend/AI Changes** (e.g., model fine-tuning, Redis caching, Supabase migrations)

## 🎨 Design Mockups / Flowcharts (Optional)
If you have UI mockups, visual outlines, or flowcharts, please embed them here!

## 🌍 Environmental or Technical Impact
How does this contribute to GreenGuard's environmental conservation mission or enhance repository scalability/robustness?

## 📝 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 💡 Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
